posts.title: listening | friday oct 2 2026
posts.description: It’s new music Friday the day that we listen to new music or at least music that is new to us. First up it’s the new UPSTATE album “Abalone” exclusive to Bandcamp (for one month)(. I really liked the closing track, “Being.” Abalone, by Upstate - I know these are parents and I really liked the lyrics and themes of navigating the individuality of songs amidst the sacrificial lifestyle of parenting.
